ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

About the role
We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.
This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.
You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

• 
Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure
• 
Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)
• 
Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision
• 
Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors
• 
Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation
• 
CPA
Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential
We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:
• 
Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house
• 
Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.
• 
Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.

About The Role & Team

As a Financial Data Analyst, you will support our financial analytics team through hands-on data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and data-quality activities. You will work closely with finance stakeholders, senior analysts, and IT teams to maintain and enhance reporting solutions and provide reliable, timely analytical support.

This role is suited to someone with a strong foundation in SQL and Power BI who enjoys working closely with data, collaborating with business users, and continuously improving reporting systems.

What You’ll Do

Power BI Report Support & Development

• Maintain and enhance existing Power BI dashboards and reports used in financial analysis.
• Assist in building new visuals and reports based on business requirements from finance and other departments.

SQL Data Integration & Analysis

• Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve and transform financial data from various sources.
• Support the integration of new data into existing reporting structures, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

Data Quality & Monitoring

• Monitor scheduled data refreshes and troubleshoot data load issues.
• Perform data validation and cleansing to ensure accurate reporting.

Documentation & Support

• Maintain up-to-date documentation of datasets, data models, and report structures.
• Provide ad hoc analytical support to stakeholders in finance, ensuring quick turnaround for BaU requests.

Collaboration

• Work closely with senior analysts, finance stakeholders, and IT teams to understand reporting needs.
• Contribute to ongoing efforts to standardize and improve reporting processes.

Qualifications

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 2–3 years of experience in a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst role.
• Solid SQL skills, with experience writing queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
• Working knowledge of Power BI, including building and modifying reports, DAX, Power Query, and data models.
• Understanding of financial datasets or interest in developing domain knowledge in finance.
• Familiarity with data quality practices and troubleshooting data issues.
• Exposure to Agile ways of working and tools like Azure DevOps is a plus.
• Clear communication skills and willingness to engage with both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset, ready to support and learn from more experienced team members.
• Detail-oriented and analytical, with the ability to spot issues in data and resolve them effectively.
• Comfortable working in an environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent tasks.
• Proactive and eager to improve Power BI and SQL skills in a practical business setting.
